key_features.Warranty: 2 years for device including humidifier under normal operation

Technical details.Sound level: ≤30 dB(A), manufacturer specification; test conditions not supplied
Technical details.Smart features: Auto On, Auto Off, automatic altitude compensation, leak compensation

Package and warranty.Confirmed supplied pack: One device with integrated humidifier, one nasal mask, one reusable filter, one power cord, one SD card, one breathing circuit and one carrying bag.
Package and warranty.Package evidence: Current manufacturer model page and approved pack confirmation checked 2026-10-28 include one of each listed item and a carrying bag. The brochure depicts six items without specifying the bag/quantities.
Package and warranty.Warranty: Device including humidifier: 2 years under normal operation. Power adapter and SD card: 1 year each. Mask, tube and water tank: 90 days each.
Package and warranty.Conditions and exclusions: Excludes damage associated with operation outside specifications, accessories not supplied or recommended by Home Medix, and technical changes without company consent. Unauthorized disassembly or repair can remove free-maintenance eligibility.
Package and warranty.Unconfirmed terms: Warranty start date, claim process, registration and purchase-channel rules, labour and transport charges remain unconfirmed; agree these with Home Medix before purchase.

Reporting and support.Home Medix Claro: Windows/macOS desktop reports; activation code required from Home Medix. Mobile QR-code report retrieval and PDF export described on downloads page.
Reporting and support.Reported measures: AHI, usage, pressure, leak and respiratory-event trends; brochure labels obstructive/central apnoea, hypopnoea, flow limitation and snoring. Device event flags are not a diagnosis.
Reporting and support.Connectivity limitations: Automatic clinic cloud upload, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, heated-tube compatibility and SpO₂ integration not established by reviewed sources.
Reporting and support.Support: Home Medix service: +91 95137 55596; service@homemedix.in; Monday–Saturday 10 am–6 pm. Location, assessment, turnaround and charges require confirmation.

faqs.a: CPAP, APAP, at 4–20 cmH₂O according to the manufacturer brochure. The treating team must confirm the prescribed mode and settings.

faqs.q: What package and warranty are confirmed?
faqs.a: One device with integrated humidifier, one nasal mask, one reusable filter, one power cord, one SD card, one breathing circuit and one carrying bag. Device including humidifier: 2 years under normal operation. Power adapter and SD card: 1 year each. Mask, tube and water tank: 90 days each. Excludes damage associated with operation outside specifications, accessories not supplied or recommended by Home Medix, and technical changes without company consent. Unauthorized disassembly or repair can remove free-maintenance eligibility. Warranty start date, claim process, registration and purchase-channel rules, labour and transport charges remain unconfirmed; agree these with Home Medix before purchase.

faqs.q: How can the therapy data be reviewed?
faqs.a: Home Medix describes Claro desktop memory-card import for Windows/macOS and mobile QR-code reports/PDF export. Confirm software activation and demonstrate an export to the treating team. Automatic clinic cloud access is not established by the reviewed sources.

description_text: Home Medix HM-CV-20 supports CPAP, APAP across 4–20 cmH₂O, with integrated humidification, manufacturer-listed ≤30 dB(A) sound and 1.45 kg weight. Claro provides therapy reporting. Manufacturer-published price checked 28 October 2026: ₹30,000 before 5% GST, ₹31,500 including GST. Device including humidifier: 2 years under normal operation. Power adapter and SD card: 1 year each. Mask, tube and water tank: 90 days each. Confirm clinical suitability, package and local support before purchase.
